tokens.name: surface-base
tokens.usage: Popup and inline-fallback background. Fallback only: at runtime it is the terminal's own background (OSC 11 or a known adapter).

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: Highlighted suggestion row and keycap fill, on surface-base. Text on it is text-primary, text-muted or accent. Selection is also carried by the ❯ marker and weight 600, never by this fill alone.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Hairline around the popup and above its footer, between rows' groups. Decorative separator, not a control boundary.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Labels and typed text on surface-base and surface-selected. At runtime the terminal's foreground (OSC 10).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Descriptions, footer context and ghost text on surface-base and surface-selected. Always at least 4.5:1.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The selected-row marker, matched characters and the focus ring, on surface-base and surface-selected. Use ANSI accent only when verified and contrast-adjusted.

tokens.name: text-match
tokens.usage: Characters of a label that match what the user typed, drawn bold and underlined so colour is never the only cue.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Solid 2px outline on a focused control, 3:1 or more on surface-base and surface-selected in both themes.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Decorative fills only (the cover). Never text, never a control boundary.

families.mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, "DejaVu Sans Mono", monospace

styles.name: row-description
styles.usage: Single-line description, truncated with an ellipsis.

styles.name: footer
styles.usage: Footer context line and key hints.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a glyph and its label; keycap padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Row horizontal padding; gap between columns.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Footer padding; popup offset from the caret line.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Inline-fallback and notice padding.

tokens.name: radius-key
tokens.usage: Keycaps.

tokens.name: radius-row
tokens.usage: Highlighted suggestion row.

tokens.name: radius-popup
tokens.usage: Popup, inline fallback, permission notice.

size.note: Popup geometry from the UX spec: 320–520 px wide, rows 28 px or taller for pointer use.

tokens.name: popup-width-min
tokens.usage: Narrowest popup.

tokens.name: popup-width-max
tokens.usage: Widest popup.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: Minimum suggestion row height.

tokens.name: popup-shadow
tokens.usage: Native overlay only, and only when the compositor allows it. Inline fallback has none.
